name: Muha Meds | 1g 510 Cartridge | Blue Slushie
description: Cool down with the unmistakable taste of Blue Slushie, a sweet and tangy blue raspberry blend that hits just like an ice-cold slushie on a scorching summer day. Bursting with bold flavor and a crisp, frosty twist, every inhale delivers an irresistibly delicious experience.
